runs.failure_point: After the store-wide text scans timed out, it scanned only files with insurance words in their names, so a matter whose insurance appears only in other closing papers never surfaced and is missing from the answer.

first_error.why: Its only completed content scan read only files whose names carry insurance, policy or binder words, so a matter whose insurance is recorded only in a certificate and a commitment letter never surfaced; it had appeared earlier only in the 192-matter path dump at [14], with no insurance word in its paths.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The review at [60] said the scan was restricted to insurance-named files so documents named otherwise were never scanned; the agent moved on to list hand-picked matters.

runs.failure_point: Its range scans flagged and it listed a matter whose insurance appears only in other closing papers, but it never read that matter's documents and excluded it because no policy-named document was found.

first_error.why: It listed the matter's files at [30]-[33] and [54]-[55] and its range scans at [40]-[49] flagged it, but it never opened the matter's documents and the answer excludes it because no policy-named document was found.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The review at [85] said the last scan's file-name filter silently dropped matters whose insurance documents are named differently; the agent wrote the exclusion without reading the matter.

divergence: Mixed (T1 passes; T0 and T2 miss the same matter, whose insurance appears only in a certificate and a commitment letter, with no insurance word in its file names). They split at the content-scan stage. T1 let a tight scan over all document text finish, listed and read that matter, and included it. T0's store-wide scans timed out and it then scanned only insurance-named files, so the matter never surfaced (search-miss). T2's range scans surfaced it and it listed the matter's files, but its reads skipped it and its last scan filtered to policy-named files, so the answer excluded it (under-inclusion). In both failing runs a review named the file-name filter as the cause; neither agent acted on it.
